Details: CreateModularModel[c, fields, FieldWeights -> <|id -> kf, ...|>] gives an empty model whose fields carry exact rational weight labels kf (for example 1/2) (actual weight -kf) over a group or context with an S,T assignment.

Options: FieldWeights (required), SuperpotentialWeight (kW, default 0), and Name, TargetIrrep (degree one), Arithmetic, WorkingPrecision, Tolerance as CreateModel. Each call starts a new form-slot namespace.
CreateModularModel.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], c, d, one, df, rf, m0}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; c = RepresentationContext[g]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; df = CreateField[c, d, "D"]; rf = CreateField[c, one, "R"]; m0 = CreateModularModel[c, {df, rf}, FieldWeights -> <|df["ID"] -> 1, rf["ID"] -> 1|>]; Values[First[m0]["ModularData"]["ActualFieldWeights"]]]

Details: FieldModularWeight[m, f] gives the weight label kf of the field f (a Field or field ID) of the modular model m; the field's actual weight is -kf.

Details: WeightedRepVector[data] is a representation-valued vector with one actual modular weight (an exact rational) per channel, and the form-slot records its channels use; read it with WeightedVectorData.

Details: MakeWeightedRepVector[v, weights] attaches one actual weight (an exact rational) to every channel of the RepVector v; weights is keyed by channel ID or by record position 1..n.
The weights are a declared grading; a modular model checks them against the field content when the vector is used as a factor.

Details: ModularFormCandidates[m, factors] gives the formal modular-form spaces and copies (slots) that a product of the model's fields needs to reach its target at the model's weight kW.

For a choice of factor channels of actual weight w the forms need kY = kW - w; a known count d gives d slots, an unknown count or missing spectrum makes the report incomplete instead of zero. A space established by SupplyModularFormSpace gives its supplied number of slots with Status "Supplied" in "Spaces"; "Complete" is then conditional on the user's spanning claim. Options: TargetIrreps, DimensionCache.
ModularFormCandidates.Example: Module[{g = BuildGroup[GroupPresentation[{"s","t"}, {"s^2","t^2","(s.t)^3"}], StoreGAPState -> False], c, d, one, df, rf, m0}, AssignModularGenerators[g, GroupWord["t^-1.s.t"], GroupWord["s"], StoreGAPState -> False]; c = RepresentationContext[g]; d = First[Select[g["IrrepOrder"], RepDim[GroupRepresentation[g, #]] === 2 &]]; one = g["CharacterData"]["TrivialIrrepID"]; df = CreateField[c, d, "D"]; rf = CreateField[c, one, "R"]; m0 = CreateModularModel[c, {df, rf}, FieldWeights -> <|df["ID"] -> 1, rf["ID"] -> 1|>]; With[{cand = ModularFormCandidates[m0, {df, rf}]}, {cand["Complete"], Length[cand["Slots"]]}]]

Details: ModularFormCandidateData[data] is the immutable candidate report of ModularFormCandidates: Complete, Slots, Spaces, Unknown, Combinations, TargetIrreps and Factors (read by property name).
